instructions: Template only, not a measured receipt; replace placeholders with verified identities.
Run metrics within the business environment. Never export images, masks, overlays, screenshots or file paths.
Read source role from the frozen revision, not the current UI label. Never move VERIFY into training.
Without frozen GT keep GT-dependent metrics null; do not infer zero from missing measurements.
Use class-agnostic geometric matching before class assessment. Multi-GT scenes need a separate evaluator; do not merge masks silently.
Preserve pre-NMS, examined, suppressed, unexamined, returned and mask-rejected counts plus elapsed_ms. Full post-NMS count is null if truncated.
ClassConfusion indicates a matched wrong class; unmatched other-class candidates alone do not establish which object was misclassified.
This diagnostic API is implemented in the R&D source library, not yet wired into the existing business GUI or typed receipt ABI.
